class.name: RosNode
class.brief_description: A ROS 2 Node that manages publishers, subscribers, and other communication interfaces.
class.description: The [RosNode] is the primary interface for interacting with the ROS 2 network. It provides factory methods to create publishers, subscribers, clients, and services, and allows management of node-level parameters and timers. A node must be initialized using [method init] before it can be used to create other communication components.

method.name: count_publishers
method.description: Returns the number of publishers currently active on a specific [param topic] in the ROS 2 graph.

method.name: count_subscribers
method.description: Returns the number of subscribers currently active on a specific [param topic] in the ROS 2 graph.

method.name: create_action_client
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosActionClient] for the specified [param action_name] and [param action_type] (e.g. [code]"example_interfaces/action/Fibonacci"[/code]).

method.name: create_action_server
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosActionServer] for the specified [param action_name] and [param action_type]. Incoming goals are auto-accepted and handed to [param execute_callback] on the main thread as a [RosServerGoalHandle], which must be driven to a terminal state. See [RosActionServer] for a full example.

method.name: create_client
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosClient] for the specified service name and type.

method.name: create_publisher
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosPublisher] to send messages to a specific [param topic]. Use [param qos] to configure the Quality of Service for the publisher.

method.name: create_service
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosService] server for the specified service name and type. The [param callback] is triggered whenever a request is received.

method.name: create_subscriber
method.deprecated: Use [method create_subscription] instead, which matches standard ROS 2 client library naming.
method.description: Alias of [method create_subscription], kept for backwards compatibility.

method.name: create_subscription
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosSubscriber] to receive messages from a specific [param topic]. The [param callback] is triggered for every new message received, always on the Godot main thread. Use [param qos] to configure the Quality of Service for the subscription.

method.name: create_tf_broadcaster
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosTfBroadcaster] for publishing coordinate transforms into the TF2 system.

method.name: create_tf_listener
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosTfListener] for looking up coordinate transforms in the TF2 system.

method.name: create_timer
method.description: Creates and returns a [RosTimer] that triggers the [param callback] at the specified [param seconds] interval, synced with the ROS 2 executor's clock.

method.name: declare_parameter
method.description: Declares a parameter on the node with a [param default_value]. Parameters must be declared before they can be retrieved or modified by external tools.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the name of the node as registered in the ROS 2 graph.

method.name: get_namespace
method.description: Returns the namespace of the node.

method.name: get_parameter
method.description: Returns the current value of the parameter with the specified [param name].

method.name: get_topic_names_and_types
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] containing all currently active topic names as keys and their associated message types as values.

method.name: init
method.description: Initializes the node with a [param node_name] and an optional [param namespace]. This must be called before using any other functions of the node.

method.name: now
method.description: Returns the current ROS 2 system time as a [RosMsg] of type [code]builtin_interfaces/msg/Time[/code].

method.name: resolve_frame
method.description: Prepends the node's namespace to a [param frame_id] if it is not already absolute, helping resolve local frame names in multi-agent simulations.

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Sets the value of a previously declared parameter on the node.

signal.name: parameter_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever a node parameter is updated by an external tool or by [method set_parameter] locally.
